text_block_list.text:
The prelude to the spring Classic GⅠs! The 
Tulip Sho is about to begin!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, somehow... It feels just like the 
starting grid.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the starting line of a motorcycle 
race. I feel like I've finally managed to 
stand there...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
At last year's Hanshin JF, I was terrified 
and had no idea what was happening. But 
now—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I've got a clear view of where my feet 
are, too. This is where the real start 
begins!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, the reason I can stay calm is all 
thanks to you. Because you've always gone 
along with my reckless ideas.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"And then... it's also a little bit 
because that guy is around, I guess."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that nagging Daiwa Scarlet. Just 
yesterday in our room, she—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"I'm the star tomorrow! I'm the tulip 
blossom, and you're just the stem—a plain 
old stem!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
The hell did you say, you punk! You're 
nothin' but fertilizer! I'll beat you and 
smear you into the dirt!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, if you hate being treated like a 
mere stem, then show me you've got more 
than just raw talent.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Could someone who's accomplished less 
than me please stop acting like they're 
better than me~?"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Argh! Just remembering it pisses me off! 
I'm totally gonna make them cry!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
When I think of it that way, I don't feel 
nervous at all. Ain't no time to be 
shaking in my boots.

Daiwa Scarlet's presence seems to relieve 
Vodka's tension just the right amount.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Let's go beat the snot out of that 
cheeky little brat!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I ain't losing to some goody-two-shoes who 
thinks all it takes is being serious!
